data.text: Fixtures are real journals: scripts/make-fixtures.mjs installs 0.1.5, 0.2.2, 0.3.2, 0.4.1, 0.5.0, 0.6.0, 0.7.0 and 0.8.0 from npm, drives one 24-command scenario (0.1-0.3 accept 20; claims, criteria and labels came in 0.4), and keeps the events (160 in all) with that version's own task list and decision list. test/compatibility.test.ts folds each with today's code: 41 checks, all green - every journal since 0.1 still reads the same. Seen to fail: one 0.4.1 event's title altered by hand -> 'KAD-3.title: expected Renamed... to equal Update dependencies'. The first run also failed on the test itself: decision list --json prints supersededBy as a label, the state holds the ULID. Core untouched.
